# Data Integrity Checklist: Task Pipeline Engine and Declarative Routing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-004 data integrity requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and objectively implementable.
**Created**: 2026-05-01
**Feature**: specs/004-task-pipeline-engine/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are task-chain template requirements explicitly bound to `workflow_templates` and do they exclude a separate `task_templates` table? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are dependency assumptions for existing SPEC-001 `workflow_templates` and task lineage columns documented before SPEC-004 uses them? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK003 Are first-hop parent lineage requirements complete for absent lineage before successor creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 Are successor lineage fields specified for workflow template identity, parent, root, chain, and incremented stage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the assignee-resolution requirement explicit that `project_agent_assignments.agent_name` and the target workflow template `agent_role` are used, with no imagined `agent_id` fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK006 Are null-default advancement requirements clear about which template fields drive advancement and which metadata fields do not? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is invalid or missing structured output behavior specified as deterministic parent failure with no successor creation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK008 Are no-match routing outcomes clearly specified as normal chain termination rather than failure or stall? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are target-template failure reason codes consistently enumerated instead of delegated to implementation-defined names? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK010 Are duplicate-successor and existing-successor retry semantics consistent across one-successor data constraints and idempotent activity/state-transition requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the reserved `task_pipeline_target_disabled` behavior consistent with the requirement not to add a disabled/status state in SPEC-004? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK012 Are shared task creation transaction boundaries consistent with post-commit outbound sync behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-022a]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are missing, duplicate, disabled, and cross-workspace target slug scenarios addressed without creating successors or corrupting parent terminal state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK014 Are transaction rollback boundaries defined for parent lineage initialization, validation failure writes, stall activity writes, duplicate guard checks, and successor insertion? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK015 Are retry conflict requirements side-effect-free for state, successor rows, activity records, and retry attempts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Does the retry success response contract require the complete bounded `chain_retry` data shape, including recovery class, termination, and idempotency fields? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-031]
